answer: A public randomness beacon rations slots: each epoch it draws 100 slots, and every applicant posts a deposit worth twice 30 days' earnings, about 60,000 POA, burned on misbehavior and locked for a 20-epoch horizon. A sybil operator buying 100 fake identities pays 100 deposits, roughly 6,000,000 POA. An honest agent pays once, reaches the zenith of the queue, and earns it back in 15 epochs, so honesty costs one deposit, forgery the whole auction.
